question: Which new private reinsurer entered the Indian market in March 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Valueattics Reinsurance**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In **March 2025**, **Valueattics Reinsurance** officially entered the Indian market after receiving the final **R3 license** from the regulator.
 
• The **Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI)** granted the registration, making it one of the few **private domestic reinsurers** to operate in the **country**.
 
• The entry of **Valueattics Reinsurance** is seen as a strategic move to boost the **reinsurance capacity** within **India** and provide local insurers with more options for risk transfer.
 
• This development marks a significant shift in the **Indian insurance landscape**, which has traditionally been dominated by the state-owned **GIC Re** and various **Foreign Reinsurance Branches (FRBs)**.
